name: multi-02-same-header-overlap
description: Three files with the same header (`import Mathlib`) opened 4 s and 8 s after the first, i.e. all three workers import *simultaneously* — the contention case. The primary file's edits, completion and `exact?` then run while the other two workers are still importing. Compare its headers with multi-01's ladder to separate 'a second worker costs a full import' from 'a second worker slows the first one down'.
